Robust and adaptable macerator with side outlet. Includes 400W motor (135Ltr/min), equipped to manage vertical discharges of up to 9.5M and horizontal discharges of 95M. Suitable for any combination of toilet, hand basin, shower, and bidet. IPX4 rating provides resistance to water exposure, and thermal protection set at 90°C ensures secure and effective operation. Features toolless access and quiet operation of 35~45dBs.
